title: Flagged for review
intro: Everything below is published rather than silently fixed. None of these items blocks publishing the site; each one blocks trusting a specific number.

items.title: NFL.com rendered Week 5 2026 scores as 'Hidden Score'
items.detail: The official score page https://www.nfl.com/scores/2026/REG5 displayed every Week 5 2026 game with the literal text 'Hidden Score' and status 'Final'. No numeric value could be read, so no comparison against the archive was possible for that week.
items.impact: Week 5 2026 is unverified against the primary source. It remains in the dataset on the strength of the 45 of 45 games that could be checked.

items.title: No official NFL source publishes betting lines
items.detail: The NFL does not publish spreads, totals, moneylines or prop lines. Every market number on this site comes from a third-party archive pinned to a commit and recorded in data/provenance.json.
items.impact: Every market line on the site is labelled third-party. No market figure may be presented as a verified fact.

items.title: Depth-chart rank is not published in the official injury report
items.detail: The official report gives Player / Position / Injury / Practice Status / Game Status. It never says whether a player is a starter, a 2nd, 3rd or 4th string replacement. Every depth-rank cell on this site is therefore blank.
items.impact: The requirement to 'know deficiencies such as 2nd, 3rd or 4th string backups replacing starters' cannot be met from the official injury report alone.

items.title: No verifiable player-prop data or prop prices were available
items.detail: Prop combos are specified as an engine (correlation-aware joint pricing, gates, staking) but no official or verifiable source for player prop lines or player game logs was reachable in this session.
items.impact: Every player-prop value on the props page is blank. The team-level combo (favourite covers and over) is fully populated because both legs have recorded prices.

items.title: Archive licence not reviewed line by line
items.detail: The third-party archive is pinned to commit 6ea0be6dd9bfc95c818c05568753bc70f1986ea2 with its download URL recorded. Its licence and data terms were not read in this session.
items.impact: Research use only until the terms are reviewed.

items.title: Weather fields are unverified
items.detail: Wind, temperature, roof and surface come from the third-party archive and have not been matched to a meteorological or official primary source.
items.impact: The best-performing strategy on the board, S-WIND-UNDER (+7.77% over 303 bets), rests entirely on an unverified wind field. It is reported, not trusted.

items.title: Only 45 of 4,055 evaluated games were re-read from the official source
items.detail: Three complete 2026 weeks (1, 8 and 9) were re-read from NFL.com and matched 45 of 45. That is 1.1% of the evaluation window. No pre-2026 game was re-read.
items.impact: Archive accuracy is strongly indicated but not established across the full history.

items.title: Linear rest term produces a large bye-week effect
items.detail: The fitted rest coefficient is 0.71 points of home margin per day of rest differential. For Week 10 PIT @ CIN, Pittsburgh's bye (14 days vs Cincinnati's 7) contributes 4.94 points, which is the main reason the model's line sits 7.06 points away from the market.
items.impact: Any own line involving a team coming off a bye should be treated as provisional.

items.title: Six overlapping NFL namespaces exist in this repository
items.detail: The repository contains nfl/, nfl-lab/, nfl-quant/, nfl-research/, nfl-decisions/ and this one, nfl-lines/. A reader cannot tell which NFL output is authoritative. A peer session owns nfl-decisions/ and this session has not edited it.
items.impact: Duplication risk and reader confusion. Recorded as a consolidation request, not acted on here.

items.title: Week 10 market lines are current, not closing
items.detail: For Week 10 the archive holds the latest available number as of 2026-11-12, several days before kick-off. It is not a closing line. The model's 'edge' for Week 10 is measured against a number that will move.
items.impact: Week 10 edge figures are directional, not tradeable.

items.title: Model has no quarterback or injury information
items.detail: The forecast uses final scores, rest, venue and date only. It does not know who is starting at quarterback. Week 10 MIA @ IND shows the cost: the market total is 38.5, the model's is 46.68, and the official page on the same day states Miami placed QB Malik Willis on injured reserve with Kyle McCord in line for his first start.
items.impact: Totals involving a quarterback change are unreliable.

items.title: LAC @ BAL Week 10 injury report lists 'No Injuries Reported' for both clubs
items.detail: The official report shows zero listed players for both teams in the Monday night game, while the other 13 games list between 4 and 16 players each. This is transcribed exactly as published.
items.impact: The deficiency load for LAC and BAL is 0.0 by construction, not by measurement.

items.title: Some injury-report player/club pairings could not be independently verified
items.detail: The official Week 10 report lists several players under clubs they are not commonly associated with in older references (for example Marvin Harrison Jr., David Montgomery and Wyatt Teller appear on the Houston entry). Rosters change every season and no official, machine-readable roster was fetched in this session, so the pairings are transcribed as published and not altered.
items.impact: Player-to-club pairings on the injury page are as-published and unverified against a roster source.

items.title: Fitted home-field advantage is 1.58 points, below the commonly cited range
items.detail: The ridge fit returns 1.575 points of home-field advantage with a rest term fitted alongside it. Published estimates for the modern NFL usually sit higher.
items.impact: The two terms are correlated in the fit; the split between them should not be over-read.

items.title: Game-page URLs are pattern-derived, not individually fetched
items.detail: Rows link to per-game pages of the form https://www.nfl.com/games/{away}-at-{home}-2026-reg-{week}. That pattern was observed on the official schedule and injury pages read during this session, but each individual game URL was not separately fetched.
items.impact: A small number of game URLs could in principle 404. The week-level score and schedule pages they derive from were fetched and read.
